subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Should ClawSweeper become the sole protected production deployment authority for crawl-remote under this coordinated cutover and forward-only D1 migration recovery model?
rationale: Code review can validate the proposed controls, but only an independent repository owner can authorize credential custody, retire the existing production mutator, and accept the operational recovery boundary.

options.title: Approve supervised cutover
options.body: Merge the fail-closed workflow, verify protected environment ownership and unique credentials, coordinate https://github.com/openclaw/crawl-remote/pull/37, and supervise the first dormant rollout.

options.title: Retain current deployment owner
options.body: Keep this PR draft and dormant while crawl-remote retains its current production mutator or maintainers choose a different authority and recovery model.

recommendation.title: Approve supervised cutover
recommendation.body: Merge the fail-closed workflow, verify protected environment ownership and unique credentials, coordinate https://github.com/openclaw/crawl-remote/pull/37, and supervise the first dormant rollout.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged workflow-area ownership signal and provides the independent approval needed beyond the PR author.
